tasks.data_origin: Generated routing instances, not collected delivery records
tasks.definition: Rows are depot 0 then 100 customers; columns x,y,integer demand,vehicle capacity=50. Output each customer ID 1..100 once. Host chooses the minimum-total-distance consecutive partition of this order whose route demands are <=50. Every route starts/ends at depot. Unlimited identical vehicles, no fixed route charge.
tasks.distribution: Equal counts of uniform and four-cluster customers in [0,1]^2, random interior depot; demands iid integers 1..9. Customer ordering and instance order shuffled. Calibration and all evaluation splits are disjoint.
tasks.target_status: Not calibrated; a lower bound is not an attainable improvement witness.
